Platinum series · AR

Arceus

Released November 4, 2009 · 111 cards

Arceus is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Platinum series, released in English on November 4, 2009. Its main set has 99 cards, plus 12 secret rares numbered beyond the set (111 in total). It includes 99 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

37 illustrators worked on Arceus. Most cards: Ryo Ueda (10), Kouki Saitou (7), Masakazu Fukuda (6), Midori Harada (6), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), sui (5), Wataru Kawahara (5), Kagemaru Himeno (4).
